tasks.name: Install localized floor protection around spray work area
tasks.notes: Canvas drop cloths around each element spray target. Discrete element protection — NOT full room. Cover floor directly below and around beam, column, and mantel work areas.

tasks.name: Install perimeter floor protection near work area
tasks.notes: Drop cloth runners near element work areas. Brush drip protection at foot of columns, below beams, around mantel work area.

tasks.name: Mask wall surfaces adjacent to elements
tasks.notes: Paper/film + tape masking at beam-wall, column-wall, and mantel-wall junctions. Protects finished wall surfaces from spray overspray. Spray only.

tasks.name: Mask ceiling fixtures near beam spray work
tasks.notes: Tape and plastic bag over ceiling fixtures near beam spray work area. Only needed when spraying beams near ceiling-mounted fixtures.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation
sop_modules.notes: Per-element prep tasks because beam (LF), column (EA), and mantel (EA) have different UOMs and geometry. MDF edge seal is conditional and mandatory for bare MDF. Caulk after fill, before primer.

tasks.name: Dust and clean all element surfaces
tasks.notes: Remove construction dust, debris from all beam, column, and mantel surfaces. Tack cloth or damp wipe. First prep step.

tasks.name: Sand beam surfaces per substrate and state
tasks.notes: Sand all beam faces. SS_BARE: 150-220 grit depending on substrate. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: scuff sand 150-180 grit. Overhead work on ceiling-mounted beams. 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides).

tasks.name: Sand column surfaces per substrate and state
tasks.notes: Sand all column faces. Flat-faced columns: rigid block. Fluted columns: flexible sanding sponge in channels. Round columns: sanding sponge wrapped around. Full height — ladder needed for upper portion.

tasks.name: Sand mantel surfaces per substrate and state
tasks.notes: Sand shelf, legs/pilasters, and surround molding. Standard wall height (H1). Detail profiles require flexible sanding approach.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on beams

quality_notes.QT4: Fill all visible holes, sand flush 220 grit.
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole. Sand flush 220+ grit. Check with angled light.

tasks.notes: Fill nail/screw holes at beam miter joints and assembly fasteners. Sand filled areas flush. Overhead work.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on columns

quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole. Perfect flush. Angled light check.

tasks.notes: Fill at column panel joints and assembly fasteners. Sand flush. Full height work.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on mantels

quality_notes.QT4: Fill all visible holes. Profile detail checked.
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole. Perfect flush on all surfaces. Angled light check.

tasks.notes: Fill at shelf-to-leg joints, leg-to-wall fasteners, molding joints. Complexity varies by mantel_type.

tasks.name: Caulk beam-to-structure junctions
tasks.notes: Paintable acrylic latex caulk at beam-to-ceiling junction (full length, both sides), beam-to-wall at end supports, and miter joints. Use flexible caulk for movement-prone junctions. Overhead work on ceiling junctions.

tasks.name: Caulk column-to-structure junctions
tasks.notes: Caulk at column-to-ceiling (top perimeter), column-to-floor (base perimeter), and column-to-wall (back edge for wall-mounted). Significant caulk per column — full perimeter at top and bottom.

tasks.name: Caulk mantel-to-wall junctions
tasks.notes: Caulk at mantel-to-wall all contact edges, shelf-to-leg joints, leg-to-wall junctions. Complexity varies by mantel_type — full_assembly has significantly more junction LF.

tasks.name: Seal MDF cut/routed edges (solvent-based)
tasks.notes: MANDATORY step 1 of MDF two-step prime. Shellac/oil-based sealer on ALL cut/routed edges of MDF elements. Beam miters, column panel joints, mantel shelf edges, leg edges. Must complete BEFORE any latex primer. NON-NEGOTIABLE.

sop_modules.name: Primer Application
sop_modules.notes: CONDITIONAL — only runs when substrate_state = SS_BARE. Factory-primed substrates skip this module. Primer type driven by substrate chemistry. Per-element tasks for rate accuracy.

tasks.name: Prime beam surfaces
tasks.notes: Full primer coat on all beam faces. Spray: multiple angle passes for 3-sided coverage. Brush: systematic face-by-face. MDF: step 2 (edges sealed). FJP: stain-block primer. Overhead work on ceiling-mounted beams.

tasks.name: Prime column surfaces
tasks.notes: Full primer coat on all column faces. Top-to-bottom application. Spray: rotate around column. Brush: face-by-face working down. Height modifier applies — upper column requires ladder.

tasks.name: Prime mantel surfaces
tasks.notes: Full primer coat on shelf, legs/pilasters, and surround detail. Standard wall height. Complexity varies by mantel_type.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.notes: Per-element, per-method finish tasks. Material system QT-driven. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). Beam overhead, column full-height, mantel wall-height.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on beams
tasks.notes: Multiple angle spray passes for 3-sided beam coverage. Bottom face first (overhead), then side faces. Lighter coats on bottom to prevent sags. Wall masking must be in place. Lead skill for overhead spray control.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on columns
tasks.notes: Rotate around column with consistent overlap. Top-to-bottom. Fluted columns: angle spray into channels. Round columns: continuous rotation. Thin coats on vertical faces to prevent sags.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on mantels
tasks.notes: Detail profiles first (recessed areas, molding), then flat faces (shelf top, leg fronts). Protect stone/brick surround with safe-release tape and film.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on beams
tasks.notes: Work face-by-face. Bottom (overhead) hardest — load brush lighter. Then side faces. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). Ornate profiles require detail brush.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on columns
tasks.notes: Square columns: Roll and Tip method (FFD SS15.6) on flat faces — mini roller to apply, brush to tip. Round/fluted: brush only, follow profile. Work top-to-bottom in manageable sections.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on mantels
tasks.notes: Shelf: Roll and Tip on flat top surface. Legs/pilasters: brush with grain. Molding detail: small angled brush. Apply, tip once, walk away. Mantel shelf is horizontal — watch for sags at edges.

sop_modules.name: Between-Coat Interstage
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat
sop_modules.notes: Universal at ALL quality tiers. Sanding discipline varies by QT. Per-element sand tasks for rate accuracy; shared tasks for cycle-level work.

tasks.name: Clean work area between coats
tasks.notes: Remove dust and debris from floor protection and surrounding area.

tasks.name: Inspect previous coat on all elements

quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length. Zero tolerance.

tasks.notes: Inspect all elements in one pass. Beam: check undersides for sags, profile corners for build-up. Column: check vertical faces for runs, flute channels. Mantel: check shelf edges, leg-to-shelf joints.

tasks.name: Sand between coats on beams
tasks.notes: Overhead sanding on ceiling-mounted beams. Rigid block on flat faces (FFD SS15.4.1). Profile detail may need flexible sponge.

tasks.name: Sand between coats on columns
tasks.notes: Full height work — ladder for upper portion. Fluted columns: flexible sanding sponge in channels. Round columns: wrap sanding technique.

tasks.name: Sand between coats on mantels

quality_notes.QT5: Thorough 220-320 grit. Uniform scratch. Angled light check.

tasks.notes: Standard wall height. Molding detail requires flexible sanding approach.

tasks.name: Patch and repair marked defects
tasks.notes: Fill, sand, and spot-prime any defects found during inspection. Scope varies by QT.

tasks.name: Spot coat patched areas
tasks.notes: Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish before next full coat.

tasks.name: Tack cloth all element surfaces
tasks.notes: Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat. Cover every surface. Work into profile detail.

tasks.name: Final quality inspection of all elements

quality_notes.QT5: Critical arm's-length inspection. Angled light on all faces. Zero tolerance.

tasks.notes: Inspect all elements. Key checkpoints: beam underside sags, column run marks, mantel shelf edge drips, caulk line quality, sheen uniformity, profile detail coverage.

tasks.name: Touch-up defects found during final inspection
tasks.notes: Correct remaining defects. Feather touch-ups into surrounding finish. QT5: may require full additional coat if defects are widespread.

tasks.name: Remove wall adjacent masking
tasks.notes: Score tape edge before removal. Pull at 45-degree angle. Spray only.

tasks.name: Remove fixture masking
tasks.notes: Remove tape and plastic from ceiling fixtures. Clean any adhesive residue. Spray only.

tasks.name: Remove floor protection
tasks.notes: Remove drop cloths from floor. Fold inward to contain debris.

tasks.name: Vacuum work area
tasks.notes: Vacuum floor area after protection removal.

tasks.name: Clean tools and equipment
tasks.notes: Clean brushes, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Water cleanup for waterborne products. Solvent cleanup for shellac-based MDF edge sealer residue.

workflow_sequence.standard_bare_spray: MOD_ARCH_SETUP > MOD_ARCH_PREP > MOD_ARCH_PRIME > MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_ARCH_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_ARCH_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.standard_factory_primed_spray: MOD_ARCH_SETUP > MOD_ARCH_PREP > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_ARCH_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_ARCH_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.qt5_brush: MOD_ARCH_SETUP > MOD_ARCH_PREP > [MOD_ARCH_PRIME] > [MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE] > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_ARCH_INTERSTAGE > MOD_ARCH_FINISH_COAT(3) > MOD_ARCH_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_ARCH_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.notes: Prime module conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. QT5 brush adds third FINISH_COAT + INTERSTAGE per FFD SS15.10.3. Three paintable items — beams (LF), columns (EA), mantels (EA). Height varies — estimation engine applies via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

round_configurations.name: Primer + 2 finish coats
round_configurations.description: Full coat sequence for bare substrate at QT3/QT4
round_configurations.notes: 3 total coats (1 primer + 2 finish), 2 interstage cycles.

round_configurations.name: 2 finish coats (no primer)
round_configurations.description: Standard coat sequence for factory-primed substrate at QT3/QT4

round_configurations.name: 3 finish coats (QT5 brush)
round_configurations.description: Extended coat sequence for QT5 brush per FFD SS15.10.3
round_configurations.notes: 3 total finish coats, 2 interstage cycles. May include MOD_ARCH_PRIME if SS_BARE.
